people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.
translations.bsb: He also instructed the second, the third, and all those following behind the herds: “When you meet Esau, you are to say the same thing to him.
